'''Crystalline Rats''' are low-level monsters found in the [[Gauntlet]]. Their counterpart in the [[The Gauntlet#Corrupted Gauntlet|Corrupted Gauntlet]] is the [[Corrupted Rat]]. Up to 3 low-level monsters spawn in a room.
